legal_units.title: Conditions of liability to pay advance tax.
legal_units.text: Advance tax shall be payable by the assessee during a financial year, where the amount of such tax payable during that year, as computed under this Part, is Rs. 10000 or more.
legal_units.context_text: Section 404 Conditions of liability to pay advance tax. Advance tax shall be payable by the assessee during a financial year, where the amount of such tax payable during that year, as computed under this Part, is Rs. 10000 or more.
